services.name: Gymnastics page
services.desc: While you’re at work, rest easy knowing Gymnastics After School provides your child with a safe, clean, and fun environment. Kids have fun learning gymnastics, staying active, and even completing their homework! The Gymnastics After School Program is offered to elementary-aged students Monday-Friday, 3:00-6:30 PM. ASI provides transportation from local schools to the gym, so you can work longer, worry-free, knowing your child is safe. Your child must be in Kindergarten and 5 years old

services.name: Drop From Class
services.desc: Our Girls Gymnastics program provides a fun way to get your child active, athletic and focused. We offer multiple classes for children of all ages and skill levels. Girls progress through four recreational skills levels: Bronze, Silver, Gold and Advanced Gold. All classes are 55 minutes and include a warm-up, rotations on beam, vault, bars, floor and trampoline and end with a game! $30 per child (upon each enrollment). The lifetime registration fee is non-refundable. This is an introductory class. Girls will learn 36 basic gymnastic skills on girls’ gymnastics apparatus. services.name: Skills Clinics
services.desc: Our Skills Clinics are designed to focus on strengthening and perfecting targeted gymnastics skills through specialized drills. Whether you’re looking to improve your tumbling techniques or enhance your performance on the bars, our clinics provide tailored training to meet your needs. We offer a variety of Skills Clinics, each dedicated to helping gymnasts achieve their goals in tumbling and bars training. Join us to elevate your gymnastics skills to the next level! Our Bars Clinic is perfect for children aiming to join our competitive team, build strength, or simply enjoy flipping more.
